rate_limits: Authenticated (PAT/OAuth/App user-to-server): 5,000 req/hour primary (15,000 if via GHEC-owned app on your behalf). GitHub App installation: 5,000 req/hour minimum; non-Enterprise Cloud installations scale with repos/users (max 12,500/hour); Enterprise Cloud org installations: 15,000 req/hour. Unauthenticated: 60 req/hour per IP. Secondary limits and GraphQL point costs also apply.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Official docs (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api) state App installation tokens start at 5,000/hour; non-GHEC installations scale with repos/users up to 12,500/hour; GHEC org installations get a fixed 15,000/hour—not “up to 15,000 scaling with seats.” Original conflated the two rules.
